title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: base surcharge per container by container size
content:
## Rule
For the hazardous-cargo surcharge written at loading under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the base surcharge per container is the category's 20-foot figure when the container type recorded on the booking is a 20-foot type — 20DV, 20RF, 20OT, 20FR or 20TK — and the category's 40/45-foot figure for every 40- or 45-foot type.

## Base surcharge per container by category
| Category | 20-foot types (USD per container) | 40- and 45-foot types (USD per container) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 60.00 | 90.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 150.00 | 225.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 250.00 | 375.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 375.00 | 560.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 350.00 | 525.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 850.00 | 1275.00 |

## Which column applies
| Container type on the booking | Column |
|---|---|
| 20DV, 20RF, 20OT, 20FR, 20TK | 20-foot |
| 40DV, 40HC, 40RH, 45HC or any other 40- or 45-foot type | 40- and 45-foot |

## Basis Q&A
- *A 20RF reefer box under AHL DG Class 9 Standard — which base applies?* The 20-foot figure, 150.00 per container.
- *A 45HC under AHL DG Limited Quantity?* The 40- and 45-foot figure, 90.00 per container.
- *A 20TK tank under AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers?* The 20-foot figure, 375.00 per container.
